title: Prescriptions Desk System Card: Strength-Error Remake
content:
When a dispensing-error report on a Kestrel Prescriptions record is of the type wrong strength and its review outcome is confirmed, the correct-strength medication is dispensed at no charge as a corrected remake. This card covers that remake and the booking tool that records it.

## Governing rule

- The remake answers a confirmed wrong-strength dispensing-error report; the units handed out on it are the strength-error remake quantity.
- It refines the dispensing-error remake of Prescriptions and changes none of its conditions: the report must be confirmed, the remake is dispensed at no charge, consumes no refill and is not subject to the refill-eligible date.
- The remake is booked on the prescription's fill ledger as a corrected remake against the confirmed report it answers.

## Capability of the tool

`dispense_strength_error_remake_b4449648` dispenses, at no charge, the correct-strength medication that answers a confirmed wrong-strength dispensing-error report, and books it on the prescription's fill ledger as a corrected remake. One call books one remake entry against the prescription and the fill that the report names. It records the units handed out, a patient pay of 0.00, today's date as the dispensing and ready date, and the store holding the prescription. No refill is consumed and the refill-eligible date is not touched. After the call the remake appears among the prescription's fill entries, linked to the report it answers, and is ready for pickup today.

## How it is invoked

The tool belongs to the agent. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `dispense_strength_error_remake_b4449648`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `error_report_id` | the reference number of the confirmed dispensing-error report the remake answers, as returned by the dispensing-error report lookup for the prescription | text identifier |
| `quantity_dispensed` | the number of correct-strength units dispensed on the remake | an integer count of dosage units (whole tablets or capsules), no decimals |

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary describing the booked remake:

- the remake's reference — text, the new fill-ledger reference of the remake;
- `error_report_id` — text, the report it answers;
- `prescription_id` — text, the prescription it is booked on;
- `quantity_dispensed` — integer dosage units handed out;
- `patient_pay_usd` — number, always 0.0;
- `ready_date` — YYYY-MM-DD, today;
- `status` — text, "remake_booked" when the entry was written.

## Illustration (hypothetical input)

A call naming a confirmed report and a `quantity_dispensed` of 56 returns the new remake reference, the same `error_report_id`, the `prescription_id` of the record, `quantity_dispensed` 56, `patient_pay_usd` 0.0, today's `ready_date` and the status "remake_booked".
